headline: Fixed: stale DNS override sent acm.org to a dead address
text: The website acm.org wouldn't load because an upstream resolver still pointed it to an old address, left over from a migration, where no host exists. The routers traced the dead address to ACM, which confirmed nothing lived there, and AS1 then found and removed the stale entry on its own resolver. acm.org now resolves correctly and loads over both HTTP and HTTPS; the fix was verified at several points.
